CfgTimeZoneHelp: Keep the time zone in step with Windows.
CfgGPUEnabledHelp: Let Linux programs use the Windows GPU.
CfgMemoryHelp: Memory for the WSL 2 virtual machine, such as 8GB. Default: half of the computer's memory.

CfgMemoryReclaimHelp: How cached memory goes back to Windows.
CfgHostLoopbackHelp: In mirrored mode, reach Windows through its own addresses.
CfgSessionCPUHelp: Processors for the container session. Default: all.
CfgSessionMemoryHelp: Memory for the container session, such as 8GB. Default: half.
CfgSessionStorageSizeHelp: Maximum size of the images and containers disk.
CfgSessionStoragePathHelp: Changing it does not move existing images or containers: a new, empty session starts there.
CfgSessionBindingHelp: 0.0.0.0 makes published ports reachable from other computers.

NetRemoveMessage: Containers attached to it lose this network.
VolHelp: Files move in and out of volumes as tar, unpacked inside Linux, so owners, permissions and links are kept.

CmpHelp: Projects run on a backend chosen when they are added. A project never moves to another backend by itself.
CmpDownMessage: The project's containers and networks are removed (compose down). Its files, folders and volumes are kept unless you choose otherwise.
CmpRemoveVolumesWarning: The data in the volumes is deleted.
CmpAutostartHelp: The WSLPilot agent brings the project up when you sign in.
CmpValid: No problems found: the project can run on this backend.
CmpRemoveMessage: WSLPilot stops managing this project. Its files, containers and volumes are not touched.

BkNoteNoMeta: Not made by WSLPilot: where it came from and whether it was consistent are unknown.
BkNoteVHDX: A disk image restores only as a new distribution.
BkVerifyFailed: The backup failed its check, so nothing was restored
BkRestoreFilesHelp: Files keep their owners and permissions. Existing files with the same names are overwritten.
BkRestoreOverMessage: The current state is backed up first, then replaced by this backup.
BkDeleteMessage: The backup files are deleted from this location.
BkPlansHelp: Plans make backups on a schedule. Backups stay restorable even after a plan is deleted.
BkAgentMissing: Plans only run while WSLPilot is open: the background agent is not installed.

BkDeletePlanMessage: The plan stops. The backups it made are kept.

SetBackupDirHelp: Manual and safety backups go here.
SetAgentHelp: Runs backup plans, restart policies and Compose autostart while the window is closed, as you, without administrator rights.
SetRestartSessionMessage: Every running container stops; the next command starts a new session with the saved settings.
SetAboutText: Manages WSL distributions, WSL Containers, Compose projects and backups. Licensed under GPL-3.0.
BkNone: No backups found yet. Back something up, or open a folder or archive from another computer.
SetMoveDataHelp: Images and volumes move to another folder or drive.
SetMoveDataMessage: All containers stop. Images and volumes are exported, the storage folder is changed and they are imported again. Containers themselves are not moved and must be created again (Compose projects: Up). The old data stays where it is until you delete it.

CtrEditWarning: A container cannot be changed in place: it is replaced by a new one with these settings. Volumes are kept; files written inside the container itself are lost.
CmpVolumesWarning: Existing data is not moved between a volume and a folder. Back the volume up first if it holds data.
SetUpdatesHelp: Updates are signed and downloaded from the GitHub releases of WSLPilot. The installed app updates itself; a portable copy cannot.
SetHelperImageHelp: Volume import, export and backups run tar in a short-lived container of this image. It needs tar with -p and --numeric-owner. Empty uses alpine:3.20.
BkEncryptOption: Encrypt the repository with a password
BkEncryptHelp: Applies when the repository is created; an existing repository keeps its setting. The password is kept for this Windows account only (DPAPI). Losing it loses the backups.
BkNoteEncrypted: Encrypted: enter its password to see and restore its backups.
WSLExportVHDWarning: A disk image can only be copied while WSL is shut down: every running distribution stops. WSL containers keep running.
CtrOtherSession: Showing session {name}, which another app created. Its containers, images and volumes are separate from the ones WSLPilot and the wslc command use; changes here affect that app.
TasksAbout: Long operations run here; their logs stay until you close WSLPilot.

SetLicensesHelp: WSLPilot is GPL-3.0; the components it uses keep their own licenses.
